sourceInformation.genre: Sports mini-game anthology with a light life-sim frame
sourceInformation.tech: Shardfall engine (Pavilion: Rust, wgpu, egui 0.36.2), commit 49ef2ba, wasm-bindgen 0.2.129, AI Hub session.js 1.4.0
sourceInformation.artDirection: The engine's cel look, high-key pastel, beach and wellness props. Library props only for generic dressing.
sourceInformation.animation: The engine puppet tilts about the feet from the balance dot. Exercise poses are hand-keyed clips on that puppet: Tree, Warrior, Fold, Squat, Plank and Bloom.
sourceInformation.audio: Music, effects and voices are synthesized in code. No audio files. Seven music beds, default music gain 0.10. At least 30 effects. Animalese voices.
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub ghost mode for 1–4 players. The round is the Inter-Resort Medley (Paddle Slalom, Tide Table, Cannonball Cup).
sourceInformation.testing: Headless sim tests, Playwright Chromium with software WebGPU at 320×180, phone and tablet profiles, WebKit iPhone fallback, and the AI Hub harness.
sourceInformation.research: The build followed PLAN.md and the engine source. The title was drawn with a real RNG from 50 riffs. No separate web search in this session.

testingFeedback: Fifteen defects showed up in testing. The first six were a gust check that did not match the acceleration model, an egui texture delta dropped on the floor, a private intent module, fonts bound in the same pass that drew them, a hub ghost field that was a boolean, and About pages that did not turn. A review of that build found eight more: sliders that never moved, Dev Mode with no jump, cheats or time scale, a free-play schedule stuck on the first four events, a Big Stand that kept its song and never showed the fake skip or the final age cut, an eyes-closed check with no tone, name and outfit lists that stopped at six, and a beach with no props or exercise poses. The drag path then failed to compile because a set lookup wanted a reference.

Three were critical. The font and texture-delta panic stops the browser frame loop, so the page sits there with a status that never ticks. After credits, seven events could not be started. A morning age of 41 to 50 could not reach the rowboat even after a strong finale.

The most helpful test was the bot playthrough: three seeds from New Stay to the credits, plus each event on five seeds against an idle player. The later menu tests drive the real pad and pointer path, including a held pointer on a slider row.

The least helpful check is a 1920×1080 WebGPU screenshot. On this machine that bitmap can come back blank while the sim is fine. 320×180 is the timing check, and the engine's own capture is the picture.
engineFeedback: The sim is one tick you can drive with no GPU, and the picture is a pure view of that tick. That split is what made the whole stay testable.

Yes. A gust is an acceleration, so gust 30 with no lean settles inside the disc and does not tip. egui 0.36 panics if a TexturesDelta is dropped. Pause still increments the tick; the world time is what freezes.
The balance model, the day loop, and every event. The engine does not have a centre-of-pressure verb.
The app frame. The demo's keys, menus and chrome run in the same function as the game, and a fit frame has to turn all of that off without breaking the engine's other scenes.

frozen() returns early inside the tick. InputFrame gained lean, device, ui and hub. The HUD carries the fit UI and a status string. The mixer plays song beds. The page bridge publishes status. Captures composite the fit UI. Puppets tilt about the feet. Splash and a silent wake were added for the lagoon. Fit pointer drags emit slider values. Hand-keyed clips play the exercise poses. The beach room gained dressing with no collision.
A supported way to publish one JSON value that is both a string (for JSON.parse) and an object (for .tick), without hand-rolling a String constructor.
promptFeedback: The plan is specific about the feel, the roster and the hub snippet, and it says behaviour is the contract when a filename does not match the engine.
Song numbers in the plan and the beds the sim actually requests do not use the same index. The hub snippet sends whatever status.hub.ghost is, so a boolean there is sent as a boolean.
Shipping the full roster, the 10-foot shell and the hub harness on a 20 GB machine where one extra browser gets killed.
Say, next to the gust sentence, that a full lean alone must not tip and a gust on top of that lean must. State that plan filenames are guidance in the same paragraph as the file tree.

aiHub.name: Wobble Minutes
aiHub.description: A third-person balance comedy at Tippy Cay. Lean through a week of sports mini-games, then stand still when it matters.
aiHub.controls: Lean with the stick, WASD or the mouse. Confirm with Cross, Space or click.
